main_block: Circuit format today. Move through all exercises before resting. Take 15 to 20 seconds to transition between exercises and rest 90 seconds after completing the full circuit. Complete 4 rounds total.
Circuit: complete all exercises before resting
Exercise 1: [IMF-181 | Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Seated] 12 reps. Press with control on the way up and lower slowly on the way down.
Exercise 2: [IMF-189 | Cable Lateral Raise] 12 reps each side. Keep a soft bend in the elbow and raise to shoulder height.
Exercise 3: [IMF-194 | Plate Front Raise] 12 reps. Lift to shoulder height and lower with control, keeping the movement smooth throughout.
Exercise 4: [IMF-172 | Face Pull] 15 reps. Pull to forehead height and hold briefly at the end range of each rep.
Exercise 5: [IMF-198 | Cuban Press] 12 reps. Move through the full rotation deliberately and do not rush the press at the top.
Exercise 6: [IMF-197 | Band Pull-Apart] 15 reps. Keep a slight bend in the elbows and pull the band apart in a smooth controlled arc.
Rest: 90 seconds, then repeat
Complete 4 rounds total
Today is a full active recovery session. No external loading. Move through each exercise with intention and focus on breathing throughout.
[IMF-001 | Cat-Cow] 10 slow reps, move with your breath and let the spine decompress in both directions.
[IMF-002 | Bird Dog] 3 sets of 8 reps each side, rest 30 seconds between sets. Keep your hips level and reach long through the opposite arm and leg.
[IMF-007 | 90/90 Hip Switches] 10 reps each side, rest 30 seconds between sets. Move slowly and let the hips open up without forcing range.
[IMF-004 | Standing Hip Circles] 10 circles each direction, use this to work through any tightness in the hips from yesterday's leg session.
[IMF-055 | Clamshell with Band] 2 sets of 15 reps each side, rest 30 seconds between sets. Controlled movement supporting right hip strength as part of your SI joint rehab.
[IMF-054 | Single-Leg Glute Bridge] 2 sets of 12 reps each side, rest 30 seconds between sets. Focus on keeping the pelvis level and squeezing at the top.
[IMF-028 | Plank, Forearms] 2 sets of 20 seconds, rest 30 seconds between sets. Breathe steadily and hold without holding your breath.
[IMF-026 | Pallof Press] 2 sets of 10 reps each side, rest 30 seconds between sets. Slow press out and controlled return, this one directly supports your SI joint stability.
[IMF-283 | Foam Roll, Upper Back] 60 seconds, work slowly up and down the upper back and pause on any tight spots.
[IMF-284 | Foam Roll, Glutes] 60 seconds each side, take your time here after two leg days this week.
Traditional sets today. Take the full rest between every set and focus on clean movement over heavy weight.
[IMF-183 | Machine Shoulder Press] 3 sets of 10 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets. The machine gives you a stable path so you can press with control even when energy is low.
[IMF-188 | Dumbbell Lateral Raise] 3 sets of 12 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets. Raise to shoulder height and resist on the way down.
[IMF-193 | Cable Front Raise] 3 sets of 10 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets. Lift to shoulder height and lower with control.
[IMF-172 | Face Pull] 3 sets of 15 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets. Pull to forehead height and hold briefly at the end of each rep.
[IMF-197 | Band Pull-Apart] 2 sets of 15 reps, rest 45 seconds between sets. Keep a slight bend in the elbows and pull the band apart smoothly.
Traditional sets today. Full rest between each set.
[IMF-181 | Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Seated] 3 sets of 10 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-190 | Machine Lateral Raise] 3 sets of 12 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-192 | Dumbbell Front Raise] 3 sets of 10 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-172 | Face Pull] 3 sets of 15 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-198 | Cuban Press] 2 sets of 12 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-199 | External Rotation, Cable] 2 sets of 15 reps each side, rest 45 seconds between sets.
